title: SeasonalBehaviors
description: SeasonalBehaviors brings dynamic, immersive seasonal changes to your Minecraft world—altering weather, mob behaviors, crop growth, and villager trades to create a living, evolving environment. Experience nature’s cycle like never before.
body: SeasonalBehaviors is a Minecraft plugin designed to enrich your world with realistic and immersive seasonal dynamics. It modifies core gameplay elements based on the current season, including weather patterns (adjusting rain, thunder, and clear skies), crop growth rates, and animal breeding behaviors. Mobs adapt intelligently: villagers offer seasonally influenced trades with fluctuating prices, wolves exhibit unique winter behaviors like howling and seeking warmth, and spawn rates vary for passive, hostile, neutral, and ambient mobs. The plugin is highly configurable, allowing server owners to tailor season durations, visual and audio effects, and mob behavior modifiers via an easy-to-edit config file. Lightweight and dependency-free, SeasonalBehaviors seamlessly integrates into any server to bring a living, breathing ecosystem that evolves naturally with the seasons.
